title: Vietnamese-Style Grilled Pork Skewers
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish originating from Vietnam. Marinated pork is grilled to perfection and served with fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: pork shoulder, thinly sliced
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cut the pork into even pieces for even cooking

ingredients.name: vietnamese nuoc cham sauce
ingredients.notes: You can adjust the amount of sauce to your taste

ingredients.name: infused fish sauce
ingredients.notes: This adds a rich and savory flavor to the pork

ingredients.name: vietnamese herb (such as mint or basil)
ingredients.notes: Chopped herbs add a fresh and fragrant flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: nuong seasoning
ingredients.notes: This adds a smoky and aromatic flavor to the pork

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.notes: A small amount of sugar helps balance the flavors

ingredients.name: garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic to release its oils and flavor

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor

ingredients.name: bamboo skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak the skewers in water for at least 30 minutes before use

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together nuoc cham sauce, infused fish sauce, nuong seasoning, sugar, garlic, and black pepper.
Add the sliced pork to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated pork onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
Meanwhile, chop the fresh herbs and set aside.
Once the skewers are cooked, remove them from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the grilled pork skewers with chopped herbs and your choice of sides, such as steamed rice or noodles.
Note: Make sure to cook the pork to an internal temperature of at least 145°F (63°C) to ensure food safety.
